claims.author: stickies-v
claims.harm: adding USDT tracepoints before clarifying the broader IPC tracing design (#35142) may lead to discarded work or premature interfaces
claims.quote: I agree it would make more sense to clarify that first before adding more tracepoints.

settled_by.quote: I don't think the IPC tracing discussion should block this functionality, assuming there is demand for it. My understanding is that IPC tracing is a promising direction, but not a drop-in replacement for USDT today.

notes: Initial record. Recorded Concept ACKs from 0xB10C and m4ycon, alongside an objection from stickies-v arguing to wait for IPC tracing (#35142), which was resolved by the author's rationale explaining why USDT additions should not be blocked.

participants.note: Concept ACK on exposing compact block data via tracepoints instead of brittle debug logs

suggested clarifying the IPC tracing approach (#35142) before adding more tracepoints

support.author: 0xB10C
support.reason: Generally in favor of having a way of exposing data about this in a non-logging way. Especially since fast compact block relay and reconstructions seem to be somewhat of a share priority by contributors.
